newsitem.title: USA: Int'l Magnetic Imaging files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: Int'l Magnetic Imaging files for IPO.

text.p: International Magnetic Imaging Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday for the initial public offering of up to 1.0 million common shares and 1.5 million series A redeemable common stock purchase warrants.

The common shares and warrants will be sold separately and not as units. The shares will be sold at an estimated $5.00 each while the warrants are expected to be sold at $0.15 each. Each warrant entitles the holder to buy one common share at $6.00 a share, subject to adjustment, within two years starting a year from the launching of the offering.
International Magnetic is a Boca Raton, Fla.,-based company that owns and operates 10 medical diagnostic imaging centers.
The company said it will use net proceeds to pay outstanding loans, to buy equipmenrt and expand its magnetic resonance imaging centers and for working capital and other corporate purposes.

The offering will be made through Monroe Parker Securities Inc. The underwriter has an over-allotment option for up to 150,000 additional common shares and 225,000 series A commo stock purchase warrants.
